inlines.v: PORTGRAVE PORTGREVE PORTICO, noun [Latin porticus, form porta or portus.] In architecture, a kind of gallery on the ground, or a piazza encompassed with arches supported by columns; a covered walk. The roof is sometimes flat; sometimes vaulted.
